Phase 1 of three-phase pedantic Tier-4 hand audit: applied test allows + auto-fix retry.

Snapshots (./scripts/clippy-pedantic.sh | grep -c ^warning):
  (a) baseline: 425
  (b) after test allows (14 lib.rs/main.rs cfg_attr + 27 tests/*.rs allow): 286
  (c) after cargo clippy --fix (with -A wildcard_imports): 241
  Deltas: -139, -45. Total: -184.

CI gates after Phase 1:
  - cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings: clean
  - cargo test --workspace: 1111 passed / 0 failed / 11 ignored
  - cargo fmt --all -- --check: clean

--fix touched examples/src/bin only (39 fix sites across 6 files): doc_markdown, uninlined_format_args, redundant_clone, needless_continue/if-not-else. Moderation directory untouched (wildcard-imports break did not recur). No public API changes; no unwrap/expect/dbg/todo in src; no crate-root #![allow] without cfg_attr.

Phases 2 (correctness audit) and 3 (stylistic per-site cleanup) remain. Issue stays open.
